title: GTA 6's Port Gellhorn: The Town the Tourists Abandoned 🏚️ #Shorts
description:
Rockstar's official description of Port Gellhorn, a once-popular vacation spot in Leonida: "Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won't bring the tourists back, but there's a new economy in this once-popular vacation spot. It's fueled by malt liquor, painkillers, and truck stop energy drinks. Jump on a dirt bike and hold onto your wallet." Fans and community mappers believe the area is inspired by Panama City, Florida (not confirmed by Rockstar). GTA 6 launches Nov 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Source: Rockstar Games (rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/port-gellhorn).
Images: official Rockstar Games screenshots.
